name: Humungousaur
abilities: Immense strength (throws heavy objects into near-orbit)
Size alteration (grows to ~60 ft, gaining strength and stegosaur-like plates/tail spikes)
Thick armored hide (survives truck hits, high falls, missile blasts)
Shock waves via clapping; earthquake generation
Enhanced jumping and agility for his size
weaknesses: Huge size makes him an easy target and unable to fit small spaces
Cannot swim; sinks and cannot breathe underwater
Vulnerable to electricity, acid and neuroshock blasts
Weak against Kaosseffexx Ultimasauria (natural predator webbing)
Strength and stamina drop severely when sick
summary: Ben's 12-foot dinosaur bruiser who can grow to 60 feet; the muscle of the Alien Force team and one of Ben's most-used forms across three series.
traits: 12 feet tall at base, up to ~60 feet
Grows stegosaur plates and tail spikes when enlarged
notableFeats: Destroyed a Highbreed Cruiser's laser cannon to save Bellwood (Ben 10 Returns: Part 2)
Held up a collapsing highway overpass (All That Glitters)
Broke Azmuth, Gwen and Kevin out of an Augstaka prison and confronted the Highbreed High Council (War of the Worlds: Part 2)
Beat Captain Nemesis in a train-throwing contest (Hero Time)
Battled Malware and saved a school bus (Malefactor)
Defeated Khyber as Tyrannopede with Skurd's help (Stuck on You)

appearances.designNotes: Brown-and-cream armoured dinosaur, long arms/short legs, recalibrated Omnitrix symbol on chest. Alien Swarm gave him slit pupils.
Same design as Alien Force with Ultimatrix symbol on chest. Heroes United variant had spiked chest plates and brow spikes.
Shorter build, black briefs with white waistband, green/black bandolier holding the Omnitrix symbol, grey nails, green eyes, nose moved up to forehead, bigger chin.

scoring.rationale: Pure powerhouse: throws trains and ships, grows to 60 ft where he out-muscles Tetramands, and shrugs off truck impacts and missile blasts. Little ranged ability beyond shock-wave claps, slow, and a giant target that sinks in water and is weak to electricity.

notes: Also used by Albedo (Negative Humungousaur, AF/OV), Azmuth (Primus), the Naljian Destructor, Vilgax's Bioids, Gwen (Inspector 13) and a Plant Clone Ben (The Big Story) - none add appearances.
Heroes United (UA-era) transformation folded into the UA appearance.
AF S1 (wiki) = ben-15-af, AF S2 = ben-16-af.
